characters.name: Wander
characters.description: Wander is the main character of the show. He's a little orange furry alien who wants to befriend everyone he meets. Sylvia is his best friend, and the feeling is mutual. Wander's personality drives him compulsively to be helpful. His recklessness and impulsiveness often gets him (or Sylvia, or far more oftenboth) in trouble, but they usually come through in the end, whether by karma or by his cunning wit. Wander is also naive toward most conflicts, and seems unaware toward Lord Hater and other forces of evil, constantly making it his mission to turn every enemy good. The Ace: Albeit one who doesn't seem to notice that he's the ace, or would even care if he did. Season 2 implies that he's this because of a LOT of practice. Actual Pacifist:To potentially lethal extremes. Added Alliterative Appeal: He has a habit of speaking like this, especially as his Boy Wander persona. All-Loving Hero:Is friendly to everyone,eventhe baddies. Averted in "The Helper" when he is actually against Hater and tries to stop him for the first time. However at that point, he had gone just a little bit crazy from helping withdrawal.Averted again in "The Boy Wander" where we meet Dr. Screwball Jones, the one villain Wander treats like an actual villain.

characters.name: Sylvia
characters.description: Sylvia is a member of a species of the colorful horse-like aliens called the Zbornak. We don't know yet if her entire race has her aggressive temperament, but we've seen that her family definitely does. She and Wander are inseparable best friends, and she feels protective of him. She also has an appetite as big as her heart and a temper as big as the galaxy. She's not quite as optimistic as Wander is, but she tries to be patient with his antics, and indulges him lovingly until she is too tired or stressed to go on. Abnormal Limb Rotation Range: Her head can often be seen in a position a human head cannot turn, like facing backwards. Accessory-Wearing Cartoon Animal: She wears a saddle, reins and a noseband. That's it. Action Girl: More willing to engage Lord Hater and the Watchdogs in combat than Wander, especially in "The Pet". Affectionate Nickname: Wander frequently calls her “Syl”.

characters.name: Wander's Hat
characters.description: Wander's trademark green hat and holder of his other trademark banjo. But it doesn't just look snazzy, Wander's hat is as aliveas it is magic, able to give whoever uses it whatever theyneed- but not necessarily what theywant.Most people who aren't Wander tend to not get the difference, leading tohilarity ensuing. It doesn't say or do much on its own, but it and Wander are very close thanks to Wander rescuing it from a pair of would-be conquerors trying to abuse its power. It had a focus episodeOnce a Season: "The Hat" in season 1, and "The Bad Hatter" in season 2. Animate Inanimate Object: To an extent. It can't move much on its own, but it's definitely alive. Apple of Discord: Wander reveals it was this once upon a time between two warlords who fought over it to give it everything they wanted. Wander actuallystoleit from them to keep the two from fighting and, since he didn't want to abuse its power, it came to willingly be his. Indeed when Hater gets his hands on it and Peepers sees its magical potential, they start fighting over it so much that it causes it to overload and flood their ship with items until Wander comes to take it off their hands. Bag of Holding: Able to create so many objects that it once flooded Hater's entire ship.

characters.name: Lord Hater
characters.description: Lord Hater is one of several villains in the universe. He seeks to take over and rule the universe, filling it with hate and fear. To aid him in his goal are his major domo, Commander Peepers, and the army of Watchdogs. Hater tends to talk a good game, but has a lot of behaviors in common with an awkward teenage boy. His plots are usually ruined by Wander and his antics, considering him as a "friend", thus he plots to get rid of Wander whatever it takes. Amazon Chaser: Upon learning that Dominator (the top villain who can beat him in a fight) is a girl, Hater immediately hasLove at First Sightand calls her "so cool". Apes in Space:The final episode's stinger depicts a crashed US space pod with green electricity coming out of it and the sound of monkeys screeching in the background, which blends into Hater's laughter. The implication here is that he was once a space ape who was exposed to...SOMETHING in space that made him who he is now. Arch-Enemy: One sided on his end, and deconstructed. When we first meet him he's the most powerful villain in the galaxy, but his increasingly extreme fixation with destroying Wander (who isn't even actively trying to stop him most of the time) leads him to lose focus on conquering, constantly humiliate himself and be supplanted by dozens of other villains. If he'd simply took the occasional defeat and largely ignored Wander like the other villains he would still be on top, but by the second season he's a laughingstockbecausehe can't help but be Wander's archenemy, with barely an episode going by without someone pointing it out. Artificial Limbs: In Season 2, his right arm becomes robotic after circumstance requires him to cut off the real one to get away from Wander. It doesn't look any different from the original, but it's established the change was permanent.

characters.name: Commander Peepers
characters.description: Commander Peepers is the highest ranking leader of the Watchdogs. He runs all command operations, comes up with plans for Hater's invasion forces, and tries to assuage Hater's feelings when Lord Hater has been frothed into a rage by Wander or by anyone else, or when Hater drops into a sulk. Peepers, over time, has taken on the best friend/caretaker role, even though he still only ever calls Hater "sir." He is devoted to his job, and to Hater himself. Adorable Evil Minions: As usual with the rest of the Watchdogs, with his adorable personality to boot. Affably Evil: Downplayed. He can be courteous, but hecanbe aJerkass. Ambiguously Gay: There are subtle implications that Peepers may have feelings for Hater, from having aStalker Shrineto his boss to fondly watching him in his sleep.invokedDave Thomasconfirmed the implications were intentional, for what it's worth. Artifact Title: His name is something of anOrphaned Punchlinefrom preproduction; rights issues prevented his title from beingSergeantPeepers.

characters.name: Army of Watchdogs
characters.description: The watchdogs are all the same eyeball-headed race that Peepers comes from. They seem to be mellow little guys when they're not directly under orders to destroy, blow up, or invade. Adorable Evil Minions: Especially when they're given presents. Affably Evil: Despite the fact that they help aGalactic Conquerorsubjugate planets, they're a good-natured, friendly and fun-loving bunch. Ambiguously Gay: In "The Greatest" as they enjoy the carnival, they are seen kissing each other, yet they're all male. Bizarre Alien Biology: How they eat is a constant question among fans. They appear to use their eyes as mouths for eating and speaking.The first episode features them licking ice-cream cones. Without tongues or mouths.

characters.name: Westley
characters.description: Westley was the smallest Watchdog recruit, and was generally ignored or kicked around by the rest of the Watchdogs, including Commander Peepers. After meeting Wander and Sylvia and getting to know them a bit (which included saving his life on more than one occasion), Westley captured the pair, then thought better of his deed. He faked his own death to let them escape and has gone wandering off on his own since then. Becoming the Mask: Spending time with Wander and Sylvia causes him to realize they're not as bad as he thought and are genuinely nice, and ends up turning good like them. Card-Carrying Villain: Initially. His dream is to be awarded the "Hater Medal of Evil." Character Development: He becomes a good guy at the end of his episode. Cult Defector: Despite being a part of Hater'sCard-Carrying Villainarmy, at heart he's a nice kid who believes the Skullship's line on Wander and Sylvia and thinks of them as worse "bad guys" than Hater, expecting them to attack him any time they have the advantage. They ultimately win him over as he discovers what they're really like.

characters.name: Andy
characters.description: A Watchdog on Lord Hater's ship who runs his own interview show; "Eye on the Skullship", where he reports on the day to day lives of the Watchdogs. Accidental Hero: Downplayed. Comes closer than anyone else to stopping Lord Hater's reign of terror, even Wander, Sylvia and Lord Dominator, by getting the entire Watchdog Army to riot after Hater and Peepers cancel his show. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: At first, Peepers and Hater think of him as nothing more than annoyance, considering he only seems to make a (rather shoddy) pet project instead of keeping an"eye"on his sector. They are forced to change their tune, however, when it turns out that his show is the only thing keeping their army from rebelling. The Heart: Keeps the Watchdogs' morale up by making them feel "special". Jingle: The opening to his show has an incredibly catchy and pleasant jingle to it, alongside his rather shoddy yet somehow endearing opening slide-show.

characters.name: Captain Tim
characters.description: An sinisterxenomorph-like creature that Wander and Sylvia find in an abandoned space station. After unsuccessfully trying to tame the dangerous creature, Wander gives him to Lord Hater. Appropriated Appelation: Wander thinks "Captain Tim" is its name from the dog tag he fishes from its stomach, characteristically oblivious tothe obvious implications of its location. Audible Sharpness: His legs are blades sharp enough to cut through aluminum, and they make this sound. Bizarre Alien Senses: Possesses thermographic vision,despite not having visible eyes.Thermographic POV is often used in nature documentaries to simulate infrared sensing. So alternatively, it has infrared sensing in spite of no visible loreal pits. Thermographic POV is often used in nature documentaries to simulate infrared sensing. So alternatively, it has infrared sensing in spite of no visible loreal pits.

characters.name: Lord Dominator
characters.description: Lord Dominator serves as the main antagonist of the second season after arriving from another galaxy. Described as "a greater hater", Dominator is a far more effective and threatening villain than the formerBig BadLord Hater could ever be, which is reflected by the similar outfit, name, Mooks, and ship. On the outside, Dominator is ano-nonsenseKnight of Cerebusman with an intimidating voice, but on the inside? Dominator is a woman who acts like a dorky teenager…andstilla sadistic menace through and through. Her goal is to harvest Volcanium X from the cores of planets, which serves as a power source for her ship, powers, and army. This process turns the planet into a desolate wasteland and destroys it, which excites her. Dominator is all about bringing pain, suffering, and torment across the galaxy because she finds it fun and it brings her great pleasure. Alpha Bitch: She has the personality of a mean, bullying teenage girl...if said teenage girl had access to superweapons and an army of evil robots. Always Someone Better: Lord Hater spends the entirety of "The Greater Hater" in furious envy over all the cool evil stuff Dominator has.She's this trope for every single villain native to Wander's galaxy. By the time of"My Fair Hatey", Dominator has cowed every villain aside from Lord Hater into acknowledging thatsheis the 'Greatest in the Galaxy'. She's this trope for every single villain native to Wander's galaxy. By the time of"My Fair Hatey", Dominator has cowed every villain aside from Lord Hater into acknowledging thatsheis the 'Greatest in the Galaxy'. Ambiguously Gay: She's a goth-punk woman who shaves her head, is gender non-conforming in her armored form, has a traditionally masculine name and title, hates when men try to hit on her, and to top it all off, theonlycharacter she's ever able to establish a genuine connection with is the rough and tumble Sylvia. The episode they spend together even involves the two of them meeting in a karaoke bar, close-ups of th

characters.name: Emperor Awesome
characters.description: This shark-headed alien with lipstick has the credentials to back up his name. He is another of the main villains in the show, and as such, is engaged in a halfhearted rivalry with Lord Hater (who takes it much more seriously than Awesome does). Awesome has an army of soldiers with fists for heads. Abhorrent Admirer: He gets reactions ranging from disgust to violence from anyone he tries to seduce, especially Sylvia. Affably Evil: Though he can be an arrogantJerkass, he has the personality of a laid-back party animal. Alien Animals:: There´s nothing to say about his overall appareance. Agent Peacock: He's a flamboyant shark-man thing who enjoys tanning and wearing lipstick; he also rides afire-breathing dinosaur that can also shoot lasers from its eyesin combat and controls a entire legion of "Fist Fighters".He's earned his title, alright.

characters.name: Badlands Dan
characters.description: A reddish-brown bull-like alien with a skeletal head residing in Doomstone. Backed by his size and frightening visage, he's made a name for himself. Alien Animals: To match his name and middle west look of Doomstone, he has the appareance of a bull. Back for the Finale: He returns in 'The End of The Galaxy' to oppose Dominator in the final battle, though has no spoken lines. Gentle Giant: He's a massive minotaur like creature and by his own admissionwould never hurt anyone and is only faking tough. Hidden Heart of Gold:Like everyone in Doomstone, he only pretend to be evil to avoid trouble.

characters.name: Papa Doom
characters.description: A gargoyle-like alien that is the biggest, toughest crime boss in Doomstone.Or so it seems. An Arm and a Leg: It's subtle but where all of his henchmen fly, he can't seem to, and there a distinct scars on his shoulders, implying his wings were torn off in the past. The Don: He's Doomstone's local crime lord.Until the end, that is. The Dreaded: The bartender describes him as the nastiest criminal in Doomstone and he leaves his front door open on a planet full of criminals because no one is stupid enough to walk in until Wander and Sylvia showed up.Of course this is all a bluff. Evil Sounds Deep: Courtesy ofKevin Michael Richardson.He's not really evil, though.

characters.name: Oink
characters.description: All There in the Script: She is not named in her sole appearance, but recieves her name in the end credits. Alien Animals: Have you seen a alien pig before? Badass Biker: Let's see, Bike? Check. Helmet? Check. Leather? Check. Attitude? Check.Although the attitude isn’t for real. Hidden Heart of Gold:She and her gang are among the numerous citizens of Doomstone who only pretended to be evil. Meaningful Name: She is called Oink because of the fact she is a alien pig that leads a gang of bikers called "Motorhogs" what do you expect from this?

characters.name: The Troll
characters.description: A small green alien with a trollish nature who grows bigger and stronger when people respond to his insults. Antagonist Title: The episode he appears in is titled "The Troll". Attention Whore: As is to be expected from a parody of Internet trolls. His last words are even "PAY ATTENTION TO ME!!" Emotion Eater: Feeds on anger, so he keeps insulting people to make them angry. Although he also has appetite for actual food. He shrinks when ignored. Fat Bastard: He likes upsetting people by insulting them and becomes larger and fatter the more people react to his insults.

characters.name: Sourdough the Evil Sandwich
characters.description: A body-snatching alien villain who spent thousands of years building an immense fleet of destructive warships. Due to Wander thwarting his attempt to steal Lord Hater's body, he's now forced to inhabit a sandwich for the next thousand years. Anthropomorphic Food: He will be stuck as a talking sandwich for the next 1000 years at least. Berserk Button: Desperate suck-ups really piss him off. Body Surf: Its main ability is to possess people and take over their bodies. Unlike most examples, it appears that the being can only use this once every thousand years so it's very picky when choosing its hosts. This almost happened to Hater before Wander saved him, and Wander was going to be the next victim without knowing. Catchphrase:EEEVILLLLLLL SANDWIIIIICHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!

characters.name: The Black Cube of Darkness
characters.description: Being Good Sucks: Since he quit villainy, he's living life as a minimum wage worker, feared by everybody, and unable to use his talent of sucking souls. When he rescues one of the punks harassing him, the punk rallies a mob against him. Burger Fool: In "The Black Cube", he works as a cashier at a fast food restaurant with aMean Boss, and the kids who mocked him before come to order a complicated meal. Out of anger, he destroys the cash register, causing him to be fired. Crippling Overspecialization: He's good at stealing souls and being a cube, neither of which are useful to the life of a normal person. Cut Lex Luthor a Check: It's shown his soul stealing ability can be used to temporarily paralyze people nonlethally. He can potentially use this if he got a job as a cop (using it to paralyze criminals). Dark Is Evil: The Black Cube is feared by most people he interacts with solely from being a being of pure darkness.

characters.name: Little Bits
characters.description: Little Bits first appears as a stray kitten who's starving in an alien city. Of course, Wander takes pity on her and is soon waiting on her hand and foot. However, Sylvia is suspicious of her, and rightly so—she's actually aBounty Hunterwho plans to turn our heroes over to Lord Hater. She later returns with a new scheme in which she stars in "cute kitten" videos that turn everyone who watches them (except Sylvia) into her brainwashed slaves. Alien Animals: She is pretty much a alien that looks like a cute little kitty Alternate Identity Amnesia: Anyone hypnotized by her will have no memory of what happened once they get released from her control. Amazing Technicolor Wildlife: Due to being an alien kitty, she has pink fur. Bad Influencer: By her second appearance, she's leveraging the fact thatThe Internet Is for Catsto bend an entire population to her will.

characters.name: Dr. Screwball Jones
characters.description: Little is known about the banana-shaped, Bozo-haired, mustachioed alien who goes by Dr. Screwball Jones. He is the only villain to make Wander turn serious and go into cape and mask hero mode. Why? His philosophy is the twisted reflection of Wander's. They both want the universe to be happy, but Screwball believes people can be made happy by force. His doctorate is an onlinePh.Dtaped to the wall of his spaceship laptop and all, and he's quite serious (if he can be said to be serious about anything) about being referred to asDoctorScrewball Jones. He is also an incorrigible punster, so you shouldn'tincorrigehim; but Wander often does as it's banter-as-battle when the two of them get going. Anthropomorphic Food: He seems to be a giant living banana. Arch-Enemy: To Wander. It seems to be one-sided, however, not unlike Wander with Hater. Beware the Silly Ones: Sylvia finds out the hard way that this guy is more dangerous than he seems. Curb-Stomp Battle: Beats up Wander while singing.He's on the receiving end of this in "The Battle Royale".

characters.name: Major Threat/Jeff
characters.description: Lord Hater's villainous idol who had a change of heart after meeting someone named Tumbleweed, who is implied (and later confirmed) to be Wander under a different name. The Atoner: He became this after his heel-face turn. Cool Old Guy: Sort of takes this role towards Hater, trying to guide him in the right direction in life just like he had gone through. Evil Is Hammy: Even if its just an act, he really plays it up in hisFace–Heel Turnwith Lord Hater."Major Threat will not abide by such a disgusting display of optimism!!" Expy:Vilgaxin terms of looks and (former) occupation, andThe Dudein terms of name and personality.

characters.name: Something The So-And-So
characters.description: An insecure and pathetic excuse for a villain. Affably Evil: Due to the fact that he'shardly a villain at all. Apologizes a Lot: Often mumbles apologies amidst his stuttering. Atrocious Alias: Being a villain while having a name like"Something The So-And-So"doesn't make him look like a serious threat. Crouching Moron, Hidden Badass:Implied. Despite hisShrinking Violetnature, Something was able to conquer two planetsandbe the first one to get to the "Ring of Invincibility". On top of this, close observation of the Galactic Villian Leaderboard shows he somehow made it all the way to the top ten!

characters.name: Mandrake the Malfeasant
characters.description: Arch-Enemy: Of Starbella. Evil Old Folks: Pretty much his only two character traits are "old" and "evil". Expy: OfMing the Merciless Feeling Their Age: His power staff now doubles as a walker, and you can hear his bones moving with him. Poor guy can't even raise his voice or let out an evil laugh without coughing anymore. Lean and Mean: Stick-thin and very nefarious.

characters.name: Prince Cashmere
characters.description: A blue ram-like alien that is the noble ruler of Baaaaa-halla, Prince Cashmere is kind, but is as courageous as a warrior can be. Alien Animals: Just like other Baaaaa-hallans, he is a alien that looks like a anthropomorphic ram. Badass Cape: Lovingly crafted for him by his Nana Ba-ba. Beware the Nice Ones: Cashmere is noble and kindhearted, but he won't hesitate to fight anyone who harms his people, tries to take their food— or insults his cape. Boisterous Bruiser: He's as loud as he is strong.

characters.name: The Lords of Illumination
characters.description: A group of wise grey aliens who put Wander through aSecret Test of Characterin "The Box". Rainbow Motif: They flash of all different colors! Secret Test of Character: They put Wander and Sylvia through one in "The Box". It… doesn’t quite work out as they expected it would. Sufficiently Advanced Aliens: But not quite enough to deal with Wander and Sylvia like they wished they would. You Didn't Ask: One of the Lords is apparently a grandfather, as indicated when the item he is coerced into putting into the box by Sylvia is a "World's Greatest Grandpa" keychain. When asked about this by one of the other Lords, he gives the excuse that he was never asked about his personal life.

characters.name: Beeza
characters.description: The leader of the Ballzerians, Beeza is levelheaded and calm, to an almost disturbing degree. Dissonant Serenity: See that pretty, sunny smile on her profile picture? Know what she's sayingat that very moment?"There aren't any planets left in our system. We have absolutely no idea where we're going. We'll just fly through space until we run out of fuel. Or food. Whichever comes first. How does one fight off cannibals? Some sort of pointy stick, I assume." Monochromatic Eyes: Her sclerae are black while her pupils are white. Seen It All: Of the "weary traveler" variety. A giant dog destroyed their planets and forced them to move so many times, she and her people have become apathetic towards it, calling itroutine. The Stoic: Beeza and the other Ballzerians accept that Buster repeatedly destroying whatever planet they're living on is just the way things are.

characters.name: Buster
characters.description: A gigantic Cosmic Horror that looks like a cute Golden Retriever puppy who plays with planets until he destroys them. Adorable Abomination: Despite being a extremely terrifying and destructive monster that can destroy planets, he looks like a playful puppy. Canis Major: He's an oversized puppy who just wants to play. Fluffy the Terrible: Known to the Ballzerians as the "Planet Buster". Genius Loci: He becomes the Ballzerians' new homeworld.

characters.name: Sir Brad Starlight
characters.description: Brad Starlight is a hero. Just ask him, he'll tell you. But to anyone who knows him, he's more aLegend In His Own Mind. Make no mistake, he's got the looks, the muscles, and the skills. It's just his inability to cope with reality — and his rather bratty reaction to it — when it's right in front of him that makes him so awful at what he does. And Now You Must Marry Me: To Princess Demurra. Anti-Villain: While self-serving and delusional as "The Enemies" shows, by token of him genuinely believing he is the hero, it means he will take on and attempt to stop other villains if he meets one. Unless Wander shows up. Blatant Lies: In "The Enemies", he claims Wander ruined his "wedding" to Demurra. Actually, heandWander nearly ruined her wedding to Draykor. Did Not Get the Girl: Apparently Demurra wasn't that into him.

characters.name: Princess Demurra
characters.description: Demurra is not your typical fairy tale princess. She knows how the fairytale is supposed to go, and knows how to sidestep the tropes. Action Girl: In an offstage moment,she rescuesherselffrom Brad. Babies Ever After: "The Gift" shows that she has had three children withDraykor. Cartoon Creature: Like Brad, it's debatable if she's human due to her having a colorful skin and missing a nose, but she is obviously a alien like everyone in the series. Damsel in Distress:Subverted, Princess Demurra voluntarily wanted to marry Draykor anddealt with Brad herself.

characters.name: King Draykor, The Dragon King
characters.description: Demurra's loving dragon husband. Babies Ever After: "The Gift" shows that he has had three (hybrid) kids withDemurra. Beauty Equals Goodness:Inverted. He looks like a stereotypical "ugly" villain, but is in actuality the 'hero', with the more classically good-looking Brad being an arrogant, petty, and childish villain. Big Bad:Subverted, Brad is the actual villain. Dark Is Not Evil: He's a scary-looking dragon who lives in a dark, spooky world and playsOminous Pipe Organmusic.He's actually a kindhearted fellow who has a genuine, loving relationship with the princess.

characters.name: The Egg
characters.description: The Cutie: A very cute creature. Disney Death: When Sylvia roughly and deliberately dumps the egg back in its nest after all her troubles, the egg cracks and instantly loses its glow. For a moment, Sylvia seems shocked that she's supposedly killed the life within the egg. ...But after tentatively knocking on its shell to make sure it's all right, the baby inside knocks back to signal it's okay. Egg MacGuffin: The sole purpose of its only starring episode is taking care of it. No Name Given: Its species has no confirmed name. Red Herring: The hints of the Doom Dragon being its mother are completely wrong.

characters.name: The Egg's Mother
characters.description: Always a Bigger Fish: She is bigger and meaner than the Doom Dragon,Or at least if her baby is trouble. Big Damn Heroes: She came to save her baby and Sylvia before the Doom Dragon ate them. Deus ex Machina: She came unexpectedly, despite being no where else in the episode before. Gentle Giant: Unlike the Doom Dragon, she is grateful that Wander and Sylvia helped her baby. Mama Bear: She won't let her child be eaten.

characters.name: Doom Dragon
characters.description: Dark Is Evil: A black colored dragon that's no doubt evil. Given Name Reveal: Its been later revealed by Peepers in "The Brainstorm" that it's name is Doom Dragon. Jerk with a Heart of Jerk: It is a bestial sort. Seemingly, Wander figures it's only attacking them because it's the mother of the egg they're returning to the nest and will mellow out as soon as its young hatches. Nope! The baby inside the egg doesn't belong to it at all, and it even decides to make the baby its next meal. Monster Is a Mommy: Subverted. Wander thinks the dragon on a rampage is upset because its egg has fallen out of its nest. The egg belongs to an entirely different species, and it is just a big, mean dragon. The egg's actual mother, however, is bigger, meaner, and very grateful to Wander and Sylvia for helping its baby. No Power, No Color: After the egg's real mother roars at the Doom Dragon, it goes completely Grey. After that, it flies away, powerless.

characters.name: Destructor
characters.description: A prince who becomes evil after his father threw away his beloved sock puppet. Dark Is Evil: As soon he turns evil, his armor changes from golden to black. Light Is Good: When he recover his sock puppet, he turns good again, and he appears wearing a golden armor and having some sort ofHoly Halo. Morality Chain: Exaggerated. Destructor wears a sock as a puppet on his right hand, acting as hisImaginary Friend. Without the "sock's" guidance, Destructor turns evil. Turn the Other Cheek: He doesn't seem to hold any hard feelings towards his father for getting rid of his sock puppet after he becomes good again.

characters.name: Harvax and Stok
characters.description: Gross garbage pickers, Harvax and Stok are frequent participants in the Galactic Conjunction 9000 race. They are also old rivals of Sylvia's, who know her time bomb tendencies well and taunt her with them. Big Creepy-Crawlies: Harvax, a giant fly. Catchphrase: "Tick-tock, tick-tock, tick-tock!" for Stok. Expy:Stok is one toBendy. Thankfully Stok and Harvax get their just desserts.Harvax resembles a blue version of Scroop fromTreasure Planet. Stok is one toBendy. Thankfully Stok and Harvax get their just desserts.

characters.name: Trudie Traveller
characters.description: Trudie Traveller is a little old alien lady of retirement age, who putts along through space on a scooter, seeing the sights of space. She's rosy-cheeked and sweet as pie ... Until she meets up with Wander, at which point she turns "who has seen the most sights in space" into a competition that almost drives the little orange guy out of his mind. It turns out she cheats — with clone/doppleganger/android/hologram duplicates of herself. Affably Evil: While she is by no means evil, she did enjoy winding Wander up for the sake of competition. A prettyCool Old Ladyotherwise. Always Someone Better: Tries to invoke herself as one of these to Wander during the events of "The Tourist",untilThe Revealthat she had hired doppelgängers of herself the whole time. Cool Old Lady: Despite her evilness, you have to admit that her adventures visiting places make her seem very cool. Evil Old Folks: She doesn't make much of an effort to hide her less than pleasant personality.

characters.name: Janet
characters.description: Janet was a dull, lifeless rock of a sentient, talking planet until a visiting Wander found something nice to say about her. Flattered and encouraged by the kindness, Janet began beautifying herself to make Wander feel comfortable and at home. Upon meeting Sylvia and realizing she had a rival for Wander's affections, Janet's friendliness extended to Wander alone; her treatment of Sylvia was passive aggressive, but soon escalated as she realized that Sylvia would not give up and leave Wander with her. Her affection for Wander and antipathy for Sylvia reached a fever pitch, at which point even Wander had to admit she was getting scary. She nearly killed the pair with launched volcanic bombs, before realizing she'd gone too far. Breaking down into tears, Janet apologized for her actions, and let the pair depart, ready to resign herself to a lifetime of loneliness. As fate would have it thought, Janet's moon, Maurice, is also sentient, and in love with her, so she got herHappy Ending. Clingy Jealous Girl: Towards Sylvia, over Wander. Forceful Kiss: Tries to give one to Wander against his will, but Sylvia interrupts it with a punch. Genius Loci: She is self-sufficient, self-aware and knows how to take care of Sylvia. In addition, she can basically control anything that happens on her body. She can manifest volcanoes, change entire landscapes, grow plants, create houses, etc. Green Thumb: She can control basically anything that happens on her body, which includes growing and controlling plant life.

characters.name: Huckleberry Knucklehead
characters.description: A giant pink alien baby who gets lost on a mall planet, and attaches to Wander and Sylvia. Cheerful Child: Innocent and blissfully unaware of everything. Cute Giant: He towers over Wander and Sylvia but he's still an adorable baby. Small Parent, Huge Child: Huck is a huge baby that dwarfs both Wander and Sylvia, while his parents are a pair of tiny bug-like aliens no bigger than Huck's fingers. Straying Baby: Gets separated from his parents in his debut episode.

characters.name: The Insurgent Generals
characters.description: Affectionate Parody: Of military heroes likeThe Dirty Dozen, theG.I. Joecrew andThe A-Team. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: The other Insurgents never question Wild Card's antics— probably because they never get in the way of their missions and sometimes can actually help (like having a chicken lay an egg on a bomb to set it off). Cloud Cuckoolander: Wild Card loves non-sequiturs and silly random things. Everything Is an Instrument: Wild Card used a live chicken as a trumpet.Yes, it makesperfect sense. Fake Ultimate Hero:They come off as tough, badass heroes, but it turns out their plan was to just inconvenience Lord Hater as they're too scared of him to do anything worse. Their mission was to ruin his hottub, but they treat it as a great success.

characters.name: The Bounty Hunters
characters.description: A trio of bounty hunters that Hater hires in 'The Bounty' to catch Wander: Rongroffle the Huntress, Killbot 86, and the Potted Plant'. Comically Missing the Point: Killbot 86 zaps everyone into Hater's ship but Wander, which leads to a mass of Torture Room victims. Killer Robot:Killbot 86is one of these, even though it doesn't actuallykillanyone in the episode, only teleports its victims to Hater's ship as Hater wants to capture Wander alive. Man-Eating Plant: The Potted Plant is revealed to be this. Oh, Crap!: Rongroffle has this when she catches Wander, only to see a giant tiger ready to maul her.

characters.name: Ryder
characters.description: Sylvia's ex-partner (no, not in that way) who is more tough and adventurous than Wander, but nowhere near as nice. Dirty Coward: Sells out Sylvia and bails when Lord Hater and his Watchdogs catch them in his storage facility. Expy: OfHan Solo,but with none of his redeeming qualities. Foil: To Wander. Wander is innocent, compassionate, and helpful; Ryder is mean, underhanded, and selfish. He's also shows what Sylvia could have been like without Wander's influence. Jerkass: A self-serving traitorous criminal.

characters.name: Stella Starbella
characters.description: A veteran superhero who seems like aCloud Cuckoolanderat first, but is actually a badassCool Old Lady. Cool Old Lady: A superheroine who can kick ass regardless of her age. Crazy Cat Lady: She appears to be aScatterbrained Seniorwho puts her pet cat in charge of everything. Crouching Moron, Hidden Badass: She comes off as a senile old lady, but she knows exactly what she is doing. The same trope even applies to hercat! Expy: OfStella StarandBarbarella, with a name and outfit combined from both.

characters.name: Beep-Boop
characters.description: 13 Is Unlucky: His number is 13, hinting at the problems throughout the episode he faces as well as hisHeroic Sacrifice. The Ace: The most efficient of Dominator's probes, and she wants the others to take after him. Appropriated Appellation: His name is bot 13, but he adopts the name "Beep-Boop" after Wander mistakes it for his name. Defiant to the End: What does he do when a furious Dominator demands him to show the data of the planet he found so she can harvest it?He retorts that his name is Beep-Boop and deletes the files in her face, knowing well that she would destroy him for that. Dying Alone: Probably what makeshisHeroic Sacrificeeven sadder, as he's ejected into space where he burns up alone, while looking at the picture he took with Wander.Wander probably never learned what happened to him,unless he connected the dots when Dominator mentioned she destroyed Bot 13 in the season 2 finale.

characters.name: Sylvia's Family
characters.description: Big Eater: It must be a species trait. Disappeared Dad:Its heavily implied that Sylvia's father died. Dysfunctional Family: You got a tough-as-nails mother who treats her daughter like dirt, three dude-bro brothers who fight all the time, aRacist Grandma, and Sylvia. It makes sense why Sylvia turned out the way she did. Hair-Trigger Temper:Everyonegets pissed overeverything. It gets to the point whereWandereventually snaps. Hidden Heart of Gold: Dorothy treats Sylvia like dirt because she knows that Sylvia came back because she is running away from Dominator, rather than trying to stop her like she did with Hater.

characters.name: High-Nee Council
characters.description: A group of fancy aliens Wander and Sylvia try to join for help in "The Party Poopers". The Faceless: They're only shown from the neck down, but it's heavily implied that their faces resemble buttocks. Joke of the Butt: Their entire shtick is to spend the episode making butt-related puns while Wander very poorly tries to resist the urge to laugh at them. Hell, it's also implied their faces look like butts. Punny Name: Just about all of them have a pun-based name related to the derriere, such as the twins Badonk and Adonk.

characters.name: Wilmur and Orbble Wright
characters.description: The inventors of orbble juice. Conjoined Twins: If their conjoined overalls are of any indication. The Dividual: They seem to function as a single entity, and are never seen apart. It's implied they could be literally conjoined. Posthumous Character: Both have passed on about fifty years before the series began. Wander and Sylvia accidentally end up in their time when the time orbble juice runs out. The Quiet One: Wilmur doesn't talk as much, usually limiting his speech to "Yup" and "Nope", while Orbble does most of the talking.

characters.name: Emily Ripov
characters.description: A ruthless hunter ofalienslike Captain Tim. Action Girl: She can compete with Sylvia and Dominator in this category. All There in the Manual: Her first name is Emily. An Arm and a Leg: She lost a foot fighting the Arachnomorphs, and nearly lost an arm too; seeArtificial Limbsbelow. Artificial Limbs: She has a couple of them as a result of injuries from arachnomoprhs.

characters.name: Phantomimes
characters.description: By the Eyes of the Blind: They can only be seen by whoever is frightened enough. Wander took notice of them when he got scared of the forest, but they were completely invisible to Sylvia who was annoyed and thought he was seeing things until she got scared when she woke up and found herself alone. Creepy Circus Music: TheirLeitmotif, with some sinister drumbeats added in to heighten the terror. They also seem to spontaneously generate it to boot. Emotion Eater: They feed on the fear an anxiety of those who enter the dark forest, and disappear once they're brave. Enemy Mime: As the name would imply, they are spectral mimes. Face Your Fears: How they are defeated.

characters.name: Miss Myrtle
characters.description: An elderly alien turtle woman who controls the fabric of the universe. Alien Animals: She has the appareance of a turtle. Disproportionate Retribution: Tells Sylvia at the end of "The Sick Day" to get a tin of snickerdoodles out of her sight or she'll destroy the universe. Does Not Like Spam: Wander is convinced that she will destroy the galaxy if he doesn't bring her a certain type of cookie. It turns out she actually hates snickerdoodles and is apparently just humoring him. Eldritch Abomination: She's a giant space turtle and apparently weaves the very fabric of the galaxy...whatever that means.

characters.name: Neckbeard
characters.description: A pompous geeky wizard in possession of a museum of artifacts. Fat Bastard: He's chubby as hell and equally as rude and condescending. Insistent Terminology: There is no such thing as 'zapping' people; its 'translocating' them. Also, his weapon of power is not a 'stick'; its a 'Bo staff'. Jerkass: EvenWandergets fed up with him! Know-Nothing Know-It-All: As Wander tells him "Just because you THINK you know everything, doesn't mean you DO!"

characters.name: The Bitties
characters.description: Imprinting: On Wander, who is the first contact of the outside world they get. Lilliputians:Their planet alone is only about the size of a tennis ball. Pink Girl, Blue Boy: Well, more like "Red Girl, Violet Boy". At least that's what Wander thinks. Ridiculously Cute Critter: Quite possibly the most adorable creatures in the show.
